phase_1.name: catalog_and_registry
phase_1.goal: load the catalog and verify registry metadata fields

phase_2.name: fake_smoke
phase_2.goal: validate catalog-driven tool registration without a live LLM

phase_3.name: live_smoke
phase_3.goal: run a scripted end-to-end smoke on the first 10 external cases

phase_4.name: gate_review
phase_4.goal: stop for review before any 80-case release expansion
